_notes: Agent B. Every catch rolls one variant (master prompt 4.4b). Roll weights = chance x islandBoost[island] x weatherBoost[weather], then normalised (basic takes the rest). valueMult multiplies the sell price. pearls are added on the catch. accent is the UI ink colour for the catch card. Emblem art: art.json key variant.<id>. Looks: variants-look.json (Agent E). Powers: powers.json (Agent A). rank/step (Casper 9 Nov): the ladder from Common to Mythic, the same species in many grades: basic (common) < speckled, bleached (uncommon) < inkdark, silverscale, coralborn (rare) < gilded, pearlescent, moonlit (epic) < prismatic, ancient (legendary) < the elements (mythic). A perfect fight or a surge steps a catch up the ladder.

basic.lore: Just as the sea made it.

speckled.name: Speckled
speckled.lore: Freckled with sand-coloured spots, like it rolled on the beach.

bleached.name: Bleached
bleached.lore: Years in the sunny shallows bleached it pale as old bone.

inkdark.name: Inkdark
inkdark.lore: It grew up in the shadow under the pier. Its glow learned to shout.

silverscale.name: Silverscale
silverscale.lore: Every scale a polished coin of silver. It flashes when it turns.

coralborn.name: Coralborn
coralborn.lore: Raised among the coral; it wears the reef's colours.

gilded.name: Gilded
gilded.lore: Gold leaf along every edge. Nobody knows who put it there.

pearlescent.name: Pearlescent
pearlescent.lore: It shimmers every colour of the inside of a shell.

moonlit.name: Moonlit
moonlit.lore: Only rises under the moon. It glows a little in the dark.

prismatic.name: Prismatic
prismatic.lore: Light splits into rainbows along its fins.

ancient.name: Ancient
ancient.lore: Barnacled and enormous-eyed. It was old when the lighthouse was built.

tide.name: Tide
tide.lore: The tide took hold of it and never let go. It brings the sea along when it fights.

rust.name: Rust
rust.lore: It grew up inside a wreck. Its scales are anchor chain now, and it pulls like an anchor.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.lore: A garden took root on its back and kept growing. The vines answer when it calls.

frost.name: Frost
frost.lore: It slept one winter too long under the glacier. The sea freezes wherever it swims.

ember.name: Ember
ember.lore: It swam too close to the caldera vents and came out burning.

storm.name: Storm
storm.lore: Struck by lightning, and it liked it. Hook it and it calls more down.

rune.name: Rune
rune.lore: Glyphs from the drowned temple circle it. It steps from one circle to the next.

abyss.name: Abyss
abyss.lore: Something from the deep looks out through it. When it is hooked, it opens all its eyes.
